AGENTS.md

A simple, open format for guiding coding agents, used by over sixty thousand open-source projects.

Why AGENTS.md?

README.md files are for humans: quick starts, project descriptions and contribution guidelines. AGENTS.md complements this by containing the extra, sometimes detailed context coding agents need: build steps, tests and conventions that might clutter a README or are not relevant to human contributors.

How to use AGENTS.md?

Create an AGENTS.md file at the root of the repository. Most coding agents can even scaffold one for you if you ask nicely.
